gaps: The official CLI does not require an exact live team match before each mutation.
The public API does not offer bulk contact listing or product-usage cohorts.
patterns: The official Loops CLI already provides broad API coverage, profiles, and JSON output.

novel_features.name: Exact team and mutation safety
novel_features.description: Verify the selected API team before a change, preview writes without private values, and journal send attempts.
novel_features.rationale: A wrong team or repeated send can affect real recipients; each write needs an explicit, verified target.

novel_features.name: Lifecycle inventory
novel_features.description: Count communication resources without retrieving contact records.
novel_features.rationale: An agent can find missing nurture infrastructure without reading private contact data.

novel_features.name: Campaign preflight
novel_features.description: Check draft status, audience targeting, message presence, and Guardian findings before publication.
novel_features.rationale: Campaign publication can send email; these API-visible checks should precede a separate approval.
